verdict.rationale: Foreloop orchestrates agent task workflows, so plan-based daily task and concurrency limits are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions pricing plans, daily task quotas, or concurrency caps, and gives no way to view or manage them. The Agents worker list and the approval gate are adjacent features, not plan limits.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see and manage plan-based daily task and concurrency limits for agent workflows
